tess: Quick follow-up from INC-2026 postmortem 
We need a single compact remediation thread: owners, deadlines, and exact runbook diffs for the recurring KV cache eviction spikes. Putting owners and timelines here.

omar: I can take the runbook edits (triage checklist + commands). Will PR a one-pager with exact CLI snippets by Fri EOD.

li: I'll own PagerDuty/escalation ladder and the deploy-correlation PD tags. Plan: PD entries + escalation timings by Wed.

sre-bot: [incident-bot] Postmortem linked: https://pm.redwood/internal/inc-2026 
Owners: omar (runbook), li (escalation).

tess: Runbook must include: 1) triage checklist, 2) minimal commands (dry-run + commit), 3) decision rule for per-customer throttle vs global evict, 4) canary rotate sequence, 5) links to rollback snippet. Keep it <=1 page.

omar: Draft triage snippet to include in PR:
```bash
# recent eviction events (10m)
rictl logs svc/inference --since 10m | jq 'select(.event=="kv_evict")' | tail -n 40
# shard hit ratio
redwood-metrics query 'kv_cache_hit_ratio{shard="inference"}' --last 5m
# dry-run manual eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --shard=inference --force-kv-evict --dry-run
# commit manual eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --shard=inference --force-kv-evict --confirm
# quick canary rotate
opsctl rotate canary --service inference --timeout 5m
```

li: Decision rule: if >65% evictions map to single api_key -> throttle key (`proxyctl throttle --api-key <key> --rate 5r/s`) and notify CS. Otherwise run global evict and start canary rotate. PD ladder: oncall -> infra lead @15m -> SRE lead @30m -> region-fallback @45m.

tess: Timeline recap: omar PR by Fri, li PD entries by Wed, I'll open GH issue to link PR + PD + postmortem and follow up next Monday. If anyone needs to shift timelines, post here. :thumbsup:
